title: Zorn
summary_html:
This article is about a bestiary entry. For the Ultima VII character, see Zorn (NPC).

Zorns are a bizarre breed of magical creature seen briefly in Sosaria and later in Britannia. Known as "the antithesis of everything," they are capable of a number of inexplicable behaviors. Zorns appear in Ultima I and Ultima IV.
